answer: Concurrency-window liveness proof: each epoch a beacon grants every agent a private service window of signed round-trip challenges. Windows of identities sharing infrastructure statistically collide, so one host cannot speak for a clone farm without visible timeouts. Each identity seals a marble-hard throughput audit; its whisper channel leaks latency traces, and a tide of mismatched timings clusters a farm for slashing. Every extra vote needs its own machine and network path - linear cost, zero marginal influence, since weight accrues per-window presence, not per-wallet.
